provenance: MOSTLY REAL. show version (IOS-XE), show inventory, show interfaces, show ip interface brief, show vlan (answering `show vlan brief`), show ip arp, CDP and LLDP neighbours, and show crypto ipsec sa detail (answering `show crypto ipsec sa`) are the real captures in testdata/real/cisco/cisco_ios (ntc-templates, Apache-2.0; see its PROVENANCE.md). They come from different devices, so identity facts do not describe one coherent box. HAND-WRITTEN: show crypto map, show crypto isakmp sa and show crypto ikev2 sa (*.handwritten.txt), modelled on the IOS 15 output format in Cisco's configuration guides, because the corpus has no real capture of those commands; and the VTY `transport input` lines and `show privilege`, the evidence mgmt.plaintext and the privilege check read. The SSH server identifies as SSH-1.99-Cisco-1.25, the banner real IOS sends (P-04).
